verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway says every call through its URL is "credential-managed", so the platform does handle credentials for downstream MCP servers, but that single line is all the evidence offers. The Inspector's OAuth 2.1 support is for testing servers in the browser, not for running and storing OAuth flows on a developer's behalf. missing for 10: documented platform-run OAuth flows for downstream tools, encrypted credential vault, automatic token refresh, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the platform run OAuth flows for downstream tools and vault the resulting credentials encrypted, with automatic token refresh

citations.quote: Every call through this URL is logged, access-controlled, and credential-managed
